title: Yerushalayim Bus Ramming Aftermath
body: A chilling emergency call captures chaos & fear after a deadly bus-ramming incident in Yerushalayim, obtained by Matzav.com, documenting the first contact between a civilian eyewitness & the Magen David Adom dispatch center.

title: Rav Avrohom Schindler Passes
body: Rav Avrohom Schindler zt”l, a beloved and respected rebbi, passed away in Lakewood, NJ, just shy of his 98th birthday, leaving behind a legacy of Torah, talmidim, and avodas hakodesh.
